text.en: Pollination happens before a seed forms.
Every monocot has parallel veins and every dicot has net veins, with no exceptions.

modelCorrection.en: Vein pattern is a usual clue with exceptions. One or two cotyledons in the seed is the firmer answer.

text.en: A pine needs water outside its body for fertilisation, as a fern does.

modelCorrection.en: Gymnosperms do not require water for fertilisation. A fern does.
